content: Predictive-maintenance IoT architectures follow a consistent layered pipeline: raw event ingestion -> per-asset aggregation/baseline -> health score computation (0-100 style, combining anomaly/degradation signals) -> remaining-useful-life / forecast layer -> action layer (work orders / prioritized recommendations). Health scores are typically computed as a scheduled/batch job over accumulated history, not synchronously per-event; forecasting layers explicitly depend on accumulated per-asset history existing before they add value. This maps directly onto RoadTwin's Detection -> RoadObservation -> RoadHealth -> Prediction -> MaintenanceRecommendation chain.
